theme: A travel day into the Maine off-week.
greeting: A travel day, Dan — Tampa to Portland by late afternoon, and the quiet off-week in Maine opens up on the far side of the flight.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the rental most likely to sell out, and a refundable hold costs nothing to place now. You're in Portland today, and this one's been open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: The Pathfinder drive south is live
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week is the window to drive the Pathfinder from Portland down to St Pete — it opens today, and it swaps in for a flight rather than adding a trip.

needsAttention.title: December break is still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The three-week December destination for all four girls needs a shortlist and a call — the book-by date is Oct 15, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year.

needsAttention.title: 7 AM Valoris call tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: The first thing tomorrow is a 7:00 AM Teams call Mike is running with Martin and Davit — an early start waiting on the other side of tonight.

schedule.title: Flight to Portland
schedule.detail: MX 1004 out of Tampa (TPA), in by 4:55

flagged.title: NACD New England board event in Maine
flagged.detail: The Oct 28 Maine Visionaries program is asking members to help spread the word — a governance-network room worth being in while you're up here.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions — Mattress Firm, a LinkedIn Learning nudge, Nextdoor, and a Substack follow.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a direct reply from you.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: A firm, meaty fish that stands up to autumn's cooler nights and heartier appetites.

acts.line: The morning sits open in Tampa ahead of the midday flight north.
A 12:20 flight lifts out of Tampa and sets you down in Portland by late afternoon.
Dinner at Roma Café closes the travel day, with a 7 AM Valoris call first thing tomorrow.
